_comment: The REPAIRED payment-initiation timeout contract (demo/meridian): a timeout resolves to unknown, the reference is preserved, a status query precedes any retry, and the retry is idempotent on the original reference. Mounted as docs/governance/services/payment-initiation.status-contract.json. Passing scripts/payment-status-check.mjs proves the declaration and the recorded negative test agree with the obligation — not that a payment system behaves this way in production (PSI-R06).
